title: Inside this quantum computer, memory vibrates like a guitar string
caption:
Could the future of quantum computing be based on vibrations? Researchers at ETH Zurich have successfully used microscopic mechanical resonators to store quantum information, mimicking the way RAM works in your laptop. It's a major step toward making quantum machines smaller and more efficient.

Source: Sciencedaily - Inside this quantum computer, memory vibrates like a guitar string

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261109205416.htm
